svg.text: McCzarny recently focused heavily on the dcvis
and crater-js repositories. In dcvis, he
introduced detailed groundwater productivity
information and new layers for energy and water
consumption analysis, comparing a 500 MW data
center with Bełchatów city. He also refined
visualizations by showing both neutral and
inversion wind conditions, separating direct
and total water usage, and unifying consumption
units. Further updates to dcvis included UI
adjustments, chart fixes, and data updates. For
crater-js, he implemented new game mechanics
like the "Cilia Hauler" mob for essence
transport and a "patience" system with "idle
AI" for autonomous character actions. He also
redesigned the UI for Unity bonuses and added
visual enhancements like a sky gradient.
Improvements in crater-js covered UI item
handling, character selection via numeric keys,
movement tuning, and adding bedrock with
refined difficulty logic. In his McCzarny
profile repository, he updated the
generate-summary workflow by adding a
GITHUB_TOKEN. Finally, in
chromium-daily-digest, he enhanced logging
context and addressed a missing summary.
